result.instructions: Tools for Qashier, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List my open Qashier checkout sessions."; "Was the checkout session for last night's order paid?"; "Create a payment link for SGD 25.00.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Qashier data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run qashier_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run qashier_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run qashier_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. qashier_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: qashier_list_checkout_sessions
tools.title: List checkout sessions
tools.description: List online payment Checkout Sessions, newest first, with status (open/complete/expired), payment status, amount in cents, refunds and receipt number. Cursor pagination: pass starting_after with the last id. GET /checkout/sessions.

starting_after.description: Cursor: a session id; returns the next page after it.

ending_before.description: Cursor: a session id; returns the previous page before it.

tools.name: qashier_get_checkout_session
tools.title: Get checkout session
tools.description: Get one Checkout Session by id: status, payment status, payment method, amount in cents, checkout url and refunds. GET /checkout/sessions/{id}.

tools.name: qashier_create_checkout_session
tools.title: Create checkout session
tools.description: WRITE: create a payment Checkout Session for ONE item and return its payment url. It charges nothing until the customer pays at that url. Amount is in cents (SGD 12.50 = 1250). POST /checkout/sessions.

unit_amount.description: Amount to charge in cents (non-negative integer).

currency.description: Currency code, uppercase, for example SGD, MYR, PHP.

return_url.description: https URL where the customer returns after paying or cancelling.

success_url.description: https URL where the customer goes when payment is complete.

customer_email.description: Email that receives the payment receipt.

expires_at.description: Expiry as epoch seconds, 30 minutes to 24 hours from now (default 24 hours).

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key (max 255 chars). Reuse the same key to retry safely without a duplicate.

tools.name: qashier_expire_checkout_session
tools.title: Expire checkout session
tools.description: WRITE: expire an OPEN Checkout Session so the customer can no longer pay it. It fails if the session is not open. POST /checkout/sessions/{id}/expire.

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key (max 255 chars). Reuse the same key to retry safely without a duplicate.

tools.name: qashier_refund_payment
tools.title: Refund payment
tools.description: WRITE, MONEY: refund a paid Checkout Session to the customer's original payment method. Omit amount for a full refund; amount is in cents. The refund runs asynchronously (status pending). This call has no idempotency key, so do NOT retry it: check qashier_get_checkout_session first. POST /refund.

session_id.description: Id of the completed Checkout Session to refund.

amount.description: Partial refund in cents. Omit to refund the full amount.
